dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderately concave trailing edge following a smooth spline curve from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex morphology with a medium pixel radius, lacking sharp terminal points.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear leading edge with an approximately 55-degree ascent relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge line.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base-to-height ratio of approximately 1.3:1 based on maximum pixel dimensions.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Continuous convex arc with a broad radius, transitioning smoothly into the dorsal plane.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered projection with a visible length approximately 1.5 times its proximal width.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Subtle obtuse inflection point of approximately 160 degrees at the junction of the melon and rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity luminescent-cyan pixel clusters localized on the ventral-anterior surface and along the dorsal midline.
